components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-accent, oklch(0.51 0.21 277)); color: #fff; height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font: 500 14px system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-accent-hover, oklch(0.46 0.21 277)); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, oklch(0.51 0.21 277)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: var(--color-panel, #fff); color: var(--color-ink, oklch(0.21 0.006 286)); height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--color-line-strong, oklch(0.83 0.008 286)); border-radius: 8px; font: 500 14px system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--color-sunken, oklch(0.955 0.003 286)); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, oklch(0.51 0.21 277)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Model, passes, format and compare mode.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: flex; padding: 2px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--color-sunken, oklch(0.955 0.003 286)); width: 280px; } .ds-seg button { flex: 1; height: 28px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink-soft, oklch(0.45 0.012 286)); font: 500 13px system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg button:hover { color: var(--color-ink, oklch(0.21 0.006 286)); } .ds-seg .ds-seg-on { background: var(--color-panel, #fff); color: var(--color-ink, oklch(0.21 0.006 286)); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.12), 0 0 0 0.5px var(--color-line-strong, oklch(0.83 0.008 286)); }

components.name: Switch Row
components.css: .ds-switch-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; width: 280px; font: 14px system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--color-ink, oklch(0.21 0.006 286)); } .ds-switch-row small { display: block; font-size: 12px; color: var(--color-ink-soft, oklch(0.45 0.012 286)); } .ds-switch { position: relative; width: 36px; height: 20px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-accent, oklch(0.51 0.21 277)); flex: none; } .ds-switch span { position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 18px; width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.3); }

components.description: An image in the batch; state by form: dashed waiting, filling bar working, tick done.

components.css: .ds-thumbs { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-thumb { position: relative; width: 64px; height: 64px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--color-stage, oklch(0.935 0.003 286)); overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--color-line-strong, oklch(0.83 0.008 286)); } .ds-wait { box-shadow: none; outline: 1px dashed var(--color-line-strong, oklch(0.83 0.008 286)); outline-offset: -1px; } .ds-work { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1.5px var(--color-accent, oklch(0.51 0.21 277)); } .ds-work i { position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: 0; height: 6px; background: var(--color-accent, oklch(0.51 0.21 277)); } .ds-done b { position: absolute; top: 4px; right: 4px; width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-ok, oklch(0.55 0.13 155)); color: #fff; font: 700 10px/16px system-ui; text-align: center; }

narrative.overview:
A bench you bring art to: neutral surfaces, a settings column of short labelled switches, and a large stage where the image sits on plain grey. Nothing on screen competes with the artwork; the one indigo accent marks the next thing to press and whatever is in progress. The system is the category standard (a settings column beside an image stage, in the vein of Upscayl) finished carefully rather than reinvented.

Density is moderate: compact 13–14 px labels, tight groups, generous separation between groups. Light and dark are equal citizens and follow the system setting. Motion is limited to 150–200 ms state changes.
keyCharacteristics: Zinc neutrals in OKLCH (hue 286), one indigo accent (hue 277).
System UI type with tabular figures everywhere.
Hairline borders and tonal layers instead of shadows; one floating shadow for overlays.
State carried by form as well as colour (dashed, filling, ticked, warned, dimmed).

rules.name: The Art Owns Colour Rule
rules.body: Nothing but the indigo accent and the two status colours carries chroma. The stage stays neutral grey so colours in the art can be judged.

rules.name: The Accent Means Act Rule
rules.body: Indigo appears only on the next action, the current selection, focus and progress; never as decoration.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Headings and labels are sentence case at normal tracking. No uppercase tracked labels or eyebrows.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces don't cast shadows at rest; only overlays float.

dos: Do keep the stage neutral grey and let the artwork be the only colour.
Do use the indigo accent only for the next action, selection, focus and progress.
Do show state by form as well as colour (dashed, bar, tick, warning, dimmed).
Do use sentence-case headings at 13–14 px, ranked by weight.
Do keep colour transitions to 150–200 ms.
donts: Don't use gradients, glass, glows or decorative shadows.
Don't add uppercase tracked labels, eyebrows or numbered sections.
Don't tint the stage or put colour behind the artwork.
Don't load web fonts; the app must work offline with the system UI face.
